verdict.rationale: Asking whether a user can control retention or deletion of their data is a fair privacy-posture question for an online government service that holds account and filing data, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack covers data retention periods, deletion requests, or user controls over stored data. The pages cover registration, filing, payments, and account maintenance. The 'inactivate or terminate a specimen' item is an unrelated program feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
